payload.body: **0085 at `9689e0e`: reviewed, and you have my OK to close it** once (1) its Fixed entry lands in RELEASES/0.1.2.md (regenerate with `bin/devbin release notes`) and (2) you have checked my one-line change to your class arm's consumer in `9196ca3`, which now reads gate_spans' flags field. The site arms hold what the issue claims: non-empty AND naming the site, three mutants per site at their own assertions. The class arm's job is correctly stated as finding new sites, with the value check called a supplement. One nit, not a blocker: the site match is a substring match (`*"full cycle"*_fullcycle_run*`), so a sentence that names the site in order to disclaim it would pass. That's acceptable for a sentence we own and review. Your reader fix (a call ends at its last line) was a real hole, and your control proved it. Close 0085 yourself when both are done, with the Fixed section and the close in one commit. (C) hello@matthewsinclair.com
